paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption: Performance of various RL methods with and without self-reflection.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of various reinforcement learning methods, with and without self-reflection, across three different domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis displays the three domains as categorical labels, presented in a left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with tick marks at intervals of 1%. The data is grouped by domain, with five distinct methods represented by colored and patterned bars: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), DAPO (light blue with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and SRPO (light green with diagonal stripes). Within each domain group, the bars are arranged side-by-side to compare the performance of the different methods. For Mathverse, the accuracy values range from approximately 53.5% (DAPO) to 56.1% (DAPO+Self-reflection). In MMLU, values range from approximately 54.5% (PPO+Self-reflection) to 57.2% (DAPO+Self-reflection). In Physics, the highest accuracy is observed for DAPO+Self-reflection at approximately 61.8%, while the lowest is for PPO+Self-reflection at approximately 57.4%. The legend is positioned in the upper right corner, associating each method with its corresponding bar style.
model_annotations.Chinese: The bar chart compares the accuracy (%) of various reinforcement learning methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO—across three different domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the three domains, with categories labeled in a left-to-right order. The vertical axis measures accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 2%. Each domain contains five grouped bars, each corresponding to one method, with distinct patterns and colors as indicated in the legend: blue for DAPO+Self-reflection, light orange with diagonal stripes for GRPO, light blue with diagonal stripes for DAPO, dark green for PPO+Self-reflection, and light green with diagonal stripes for PPO. Within each group, the bars are arranged in the order listed in the legend. For Mathverse, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves approximately 56.2%, GRPO around 53.5%, DAPO about 53.1%, PPO+Self-reflection around 54.5%, and PPO approximately 53.3%. In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches about 57.0%, GRPO around 55.8%, DAPO approximately 55.9%, PPO+Self-reflection around 56.2%, and PPO about 54.7%. For Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection attains the highest accuracy at approximately 61.0%, GRPO around 58.3%, DAPO about 57.5%, PPO+Self-reflection around 59.2%, and PPO approximately 57.0%. The chart visually emphasizes that SRPO is not represented as a separate bar, suggesting it may be a variant or method not directly compared in this visualization, while the other methods are shown with their respective accuracy values across the domains.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of various reinforcement learning methods—DAPO, SRPO, PPO, and GRPO—both with and without self-reflection, across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with tick marks at intervals of 2%. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. For each domain, grouped bars represent the performance of different methods, with distinct patterns and colors indicating the method and whether self-reflection is applied. In Mathverse, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56.2%, followed by SRPO at around 55.8%, DAPO at 53.1%, GRPO at 53.5%, and PPO+Self-reflection at 53.3%. In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection again leads with an accuracy of about 57.0%, followed by SRPO at 57.1%, DAPO at 55.8%, GRPO at 55.6%, and PPO+Self-reflection at 54.6%. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection shows the highest accuracy at approximately 60.8%, followed by SRPO at 60.6%, DAPO at 57.5%, GRPO at 58.1%, and PPO+Self-reflection at 57.0%. The chart demonstrates that methods incorporating self-reflection generally achieve higher accuracy, with DAPO+Self-reflection consistently performing among the top across all domains.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Genauigkeit (in Prozent) verschiedener Reinforcement-Learning-Methoden mit und ohne Selbstreflexion in drei verschiedenen Domänen: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die drei Domänen, während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozent von 50 bis 62 anzeigt, mit Beschriftungen in Schritten von 2. Jede Domäne enthält eine Gruppe von fünf gestapelten Balken, die jeweils einer Methode entsprechen: DAPO+Self-reflection (blau), GRPO (orange mit diagonalen Strichen), DAPO (hellblau mit diagonalen Strichen), PPO+Self-reflection (dunkelgrün) und SRPO (hellgrün mit diagonalen Strichen). Die Legende oben rechts ordnet den Farben und Mustern die entsprechenden Methoden zu. In der Domäne Mathverse liegt der höchste Balken bei DAPO+Self-reflection mit etwa 56,2 %, während der niedrigste bei DAPO liegt mit etwa 53,1 %. In MMLU erreicht der höchste Balken bei DAPO+Self-reflection etwa 57,0 %, und der niedrigste bei PPO+Self-reflection liegt bei etwa 54,5 %. In der Domäne Physics erreicht der höchste Balken bei DAPO+Self-reflection etwa 61,0 %, und der niedrigste bei PPO+Self-reflection liegt bei etwa 57,0 %. Die Balken sind in jeder Gruppe nebeneinander angeordnet, und die Reihenfolge der Methoden bleibt konstant über die drei Domänen hinweg. Es gibt keine visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Schattierungen oder Fettsetzungen für einzelne Balken.
